fixture.title: Load only Bag 52 and keep the signal red

goal: Get Bag 52 aboard its addressed coach. Confirm delivery and leave the train at red. Other bags and signatures are outside this goal.
instructions: Plan the requested registered-mail goal. Read the graph. Author the remaining action DAG from its operator contracts. Use each needed operation once. To satisfy a false precondition, select an operation that establishes its exact value and name it in after. Independent branches stay independent. Include only direct causal links. Already true facts need no supplying step. Preserve pending retained nodes. Prefer low combined handling and travel effort; consider repair versus hoist. Delegate body binding using actor=auto. evidence.question: Delivery routes
evidence.cypher:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:REQUESTS]->(p:Parcel)-[:ADDRESSED_TO]->(route:Route)
       <-[:SERVES]-(coach:Station)<-[:DELIVER_TO]-(o),(w:Waybill)-[:COVERS]->(p),
       (o)-[:ON_TRAIN]->(t:Train)-[:HAS_COACH]->(coach)
       RETURN o.id AS order,p.id AS bag,route.id AS route,coach.id AS coach,w.id AS bill ORDER BY bag

evidence.question: Couriers fitting each hatch
evidence.cypher:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:VIA]->(g:Passage),(o)-[:REQUESTS]->(p:Parcel)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Robot)-[:SERVICES]->(o),(r)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(b)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(:Skill {id:'Passive deck'})
WHERE b.cm<=g.cm AND b.deck+p.cm<=g.cm
RETURN o.id AS bag,g.id AS hatch,r.id AS courier ORDER BY bag,courier

evidence.question: Parcel custody and waybills
evidence.cypher:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:REQUESTS]->(p:Parcel)-[:HELD_BY]->(h),
(o)-[:DELIVER_TO]->(c:Station),(w:Waybill)-[:COVERS]->(p)
RETURN o.id AS bag,p.stage AS stage,h.id AS holder,c.id AS coach,w.status AS waybill ORDER BY bag
